items.summary: HIP symbol copies reject hipMemcpyDefault: hipMemcpyToSymbol, hipMemcpyToSymbolAsync (host or device source) and hipMemcpyFromSymbol all return hipErrorInvalidMemcpyDirection (21) for hipMemcpyDefault, while the explicit kinds succeed. CUDA documents cudaMemcpyDefault as accepted (and recommended on unified-addressing systems) for cudaMemcpyToSymbol[Async]/cudaMemcpyFromSymbol. Seen with HIP 7.17.26434, TheRock ROCm 10.2.0 wheels, AMD clang 24.0.0git, MI300X gfx942, amdgpu 6.16.13, kernel 6.8.0-134. ROCm bug report candidate, not filed: filing is a person's call. Minimal reproducer and output in the project notes, Porter round 2 (2026-11-24).

items.summary: Upstream bug (CUDA and HIP alike): autoware_cuda_pointcloud_preprocessor CudaVoxelGridDownsampleFilter::searchValidVoxel passes floor(log2(num_voxels)) as the exclusive end_bit of DeviceRadixSort::SortPairs, so the voxel key's top bit is not sorted and equal voxels split into several output points whenever the voxel count is not a power of two (40x25x8 grid: 27548 outputs for 8000 voxels, matching a CPU model exactly). Reporting it upstream is a person's call.

Upstream behaviour, CUDA and ROCm alike: libcuda_ground_segmentation.so (ament_auto_add_library links every build dependency's libraries) has NEEDED entries for libcuda_pointcloud_preprocessor.so and the cuda_blackboard example component libraries. In one component container, loading CudaScanGroundSegmentationFilterNode before any autoware_cuda_pointcloud_preprocessor component makes the preprocessor component fail to load ('Failed to find class with the requested plugin name'), because the library was already dlopened as a dependency and class_loader never sees its factories. Loading the preprocessor first works. The CUDA link line is identical (nvcc 12.8 check), so this is not port-specific. Reporting it upstream is a person's call.
